scenario: You receive a message from a friend suggesting a coffee meetup, but they message a while later to say their car battery died and they will be ten minutes late.
A software update automatically installs on your computer right before you need to export a large project file.
You arrive at a busy restaurant and are told the wait will be an hour, but they offer you a seat at the bar with free appetizers.
Your manager calls a spontaneous meeting to discuss feedback on a presentation you gave earlier in the week.
It starts raining heavily right as you step outside without an umbrella, but you notice a convenient store just down the street.
You attempt to cookbook a dish for the first time and realize halfway through that you are missing one key spice.
A colleague borrows your favorite pen and returns it the next day with the cap slightly bent.
You accidentally reply-all to a company-wide email containing a typo that should have only been sent to two people.
The public transportation you were planning to take gets delayed due to signal failures, forcing you to wait on the platform.
You find an old jacket in your closet with a lot of money still in one of the side pockets.
A client requests a significant change to the project scope two days before the final deadline.
You spill coffee on your white shirt right before heading to an important appointment.
Your neighbor’s dog barks continuously for an hour during a scheduled video call.
You book a hotel room for a trip, but the airline cancels your flight and rebooks you with a long layover.
You lose your wallet while shopping in a crowded market and must retrace your steps.
A friend cancels plans at the last minute due to a sudden headache.
You sit down to work on a computer and it immediately goes into sleep mode despite being plugged in.
You receive a ping saying someone is watching your screen via remote desktop software you forgot you enabled.
You pull up to a gas station and see the sign says out of service for three pumps out of ten.
A letter arrives in the mail stating there is an overpayment on your utilities bill that needs clarification.
You attempt to connect to the guest Wi-Fi at a cafe, but the portal page times out.
Your planned picnic is interrupted by a sudden downpour, but the shelter area remains dry.
You send a document to a client and they immediately ask for a slightly different format.
You wake up late because your alarm didn’t go off, leaving you with less time to get ready.
A package you ordered arrives damaged, with the box crushed on one side.
You try to recommend a movie to a friend, but they have just seen it and disliked it.
The power goes out in your building during a storm, forcing you to find a backup light source.
You encounter a detour on your usual driving route due to a road accident.
A server you frequently rely on for work is undergoing scheduled maintenance without prior notice.
You discover that the prescription you filled today is not covered by your insurance plan.
You hear a notification that your session has expired and you must log in again to save your work.
A coworker asks you to cover their shift this weekend because of a family emergency.
You realize you skipped reading the fine print on a warranty claim and need to fill out additional forms.
The elevator stops between floors in an office building, delaying your arrival to a meeting.
You buy a season pass for a park, but the weather forecast looks gloomy for most of the upcoming days.
A printer in your office jams and you have to deal with the technical glitch before returning to your task.
You receive a notification that your bank account has been temporarily frozen due to suspected activity.
Your GPS directs you down a closed road, requiring you to find an alternate route.
A customer service representative tells you that they cannot issue a refund for your recent purchase.
You accidentally delete a folder containing important files from your desktop.
A spider appears on your desk while you are working, requiring you to move it outside.
You arrive at a guided tour and find that it has departed five minutes ahead of schedule.
Your Internet Service Provider announces a rate increase effective next month.
A question is asked during a presentation that you cannot immediately answer.
You leave a dish in the soaking water too long and it forms a tough residue that is hard to scrub off.
A meeting runs fifteen minutes over time, cutting into your lunch break.
You try to return an item to a store, but they are out of stock of the same product.
Your phone battery reaches ten percent while you are using a navigation app in a new city.
A colleague shares your idea in a separate meeting without attributing the original thought to you.
You encounter a long line at the post office exactly when you hoped to quickly mail a package.
